patentability_status.section_3p: Non-patentable as raw powder, aqueous extract, or traditional decoction under Section 3(p) of the Patents Act, 1970 (Traditional Knowledge).
patentability_status.section_3e: Combinations with known additives strictly rejected under Section 3(e) as mere admixing unless synergistic efficacy exceeding additive effects is clinically proven.
viable_ip_pathways: Novel non-obvious delivery system (e.g., targeted nanoparticle lipid carrier) demonstrating unexpected pharmacokinetic stability.
Specific isolated fraction with synthetic structural modifications demonstrating uncharacterized therapeutic receptor affinity.

abs_requirements.details: Under Section 6 of the Biological Diversity Act, 2002, foreign individuals/corporations or Indian entities with foreign equity must obtain prior approval from the National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) via Form III before applying for an Indian patent.
abs_requirements.indian_entity_rule: Indian citizens/entities must file Form I notification with the State Biodiversity Board (SBB) if commercial utilization is pursued.
abs_requirements.punitive_statute: Non-compliance triggers rejection under Section 10(4)(d)(ii) of Patents Act and penal provisions under Section 55 of BDA 2002.
